Cc: Procurement <procurement@helixpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data export mapping + DPA annex — follow-up

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our Privacy team have one consolidated ask before we proceed to commercial terms: can you provide a detailed data export matrix that maps the cross-border flows for Helix production data (including where KV caches, analytics logs, and backups may be stored), and a DPA Annex draft we can review for EU→US transfers?

Two quick clarifications that would help our legal:
- Which subprocessors handle persistent backups and where are those backups located?
- For streaming inference (session KV cache), do you ever persist caches to disk outside customer-controlled VPCs?

We appreciate a one–page summary + matrix first (CSV/Excel) and then the draft DPA annex. Target timeline from our side: draft matrix by EOD Monday and the annex by Wednesday (Helix legal will review and provide redlines).

Attaching the questionnaire we circulated internally for reference (not attached here on this thread).

Best,
Sophie Lambert
Senior Procurement Manager
Helix Health Partners
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@helixpartners.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data export mapping + DPA annex — follow-up

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. Confirming we will deliver an initial export matrix (Excel) by EOD Monday and a DPA Annex draft on Wednesday.

Quick answers to your two bullets up-front:
- Persistent backups: for Hosted customers backups of model artifacts and telemetry are handled by our cloud storage subprocessor partners; primary backups for Helix would be in US regions by default, with EU-only options available under Redwood Private or Dedicated — I will flag exact subprocessor names in the matrix.
- KV cache persistence: our runtime keeps KV caches in-memory for sessions; we do not persist session KV caches to disk outside the customer VPC for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted, we may flush short-term cache checkpoints to encrypted object storage during graceful restarts (these are transient, encrypted at rest, and region-bound).

Karthik — looping you in for legal redline guidance on the annex and any standard clauses Helix typically pushes on transfer mechanisms (SCCs vs DPF mapping). Kimberly — could you confirm where the SOC2 evidence and operational logs summary live for sharing? Marissa — FYI to coordinate the HubSpot deal record and DocuSign routing once terms are agreed.

Attachments: "Helix_HQ_DataExport_Matrix_v1.xlsx" (stub: first-pass mapping), "Redwood_DPA_Annex_Draft_v1.docx" (stub: draft annex).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data export mapping + DPA annex — follow-up

Hi Sophie and team,

I reviewed the DPA Annex draft Jonas attached and added two items we should confirm before Helix legal redlines:
1) Transfer mechanism preference: Redwood supports both the EU SCCs (2021) and our documented DPF mapping that demonstrates equivalent safeguards. If Helix prefers SCCs in the annex, we can incorporate the standard SCC Module 4 text; if Helix prefers DPF, we will provide the mapping and evidence pack (operational controls + subprocessor attestations). Please indicate preference.
2) Subprocessor detail level: Our standard annex lists subprocessors by purpose and region with on-demand detailed locations available under NDA. Helix asked for precise backup locations — we can include region-level locations in the annex and provide a subprocessor exhibit that lists exact host regions and retention windows under a separate evidence package.

Action items I propose:
- Jonas: send the export matrix we discussed (region/subprocessor/purpose/retention) — I will verify the legal language for the backup and logging sections.
- Kimberly: please attach SOC2 summary and the operational logs inventory (we should redact any internal-only endpoints).
- Sophie: confirm whether Helix expects SCCs or DPF mapping as the primary transfer mechanism.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
